term: event route: an occurring episode as a concrete entity
definition: OccurringEpisodeIsActualConcrete m concrete Occurs embed w means ∀ e, Occurs e → concrete (embed e) ∧ m.ExistsAt w (embed e), for an explicit embed : Episode → E of episodes into the candidate domain. It needs no distinct bearer. Its consequent is the inhabited-world conclusion at the witness embed e, so a proof from it is a transcription (AGENTS.md invariant 16); an inhabited Episode type alone gives no concrete entity.
note: Stipulated for #536's event-route model only. Whether an actually performed episode is a concrete particular is the open question of #544.
